target_moa.text: Humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody that binds the interleukin-6 (IL-6) receptor, preventing IL-6 binding and inhibiting IL-6 signaling through soluble and membrane-bound IL-6 receptor

citations.quote: Enspryng (satralizumab-mwge) is a humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody that binds to the interleukin-6 (IL-6) receptor. When satralizumab-mwge binds to IL-6 receptor on a cell's surface, it prevents binding of IL-6 and therefore inhibits IL-6 signaling through the IL-6 receptor. key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence at least 15%): nasopharyngitis, headache, upper respiratory tract infection, gastritis, rash, arthralgia, extremity pain, fatigue, and nausea. In Study 2 nasopharyngitis (31% vs 15% placebo) and headache (27% vs 12%). Key warnings: infections (including serious infections), elevated liver enzymes, and decreased neutrophil counts.
